chunks.head: by degrees
chunks.note: by degrees = 慢慢地、逐步地（书面）。
chunks.ex_en: By degrees the sky turned dark.
chunks.ex_cn: 天渐渐黑了下来。

chunks.head: give over
chunks.note: give over = 停止、放弃（不是'给'）。
chunks.ex_en: Give over shouting and listen to me.
chunks.ex_cn: 别嚷了，听我说。

chunks.head: leave off
chunks.note: leave off (doing) = 停止做某事。
chunks.ex_en: She left off reading when the bell rang.
chunks.ex_cn: 铃响时她停下了阅读。

chunks.head: wear off
chunks.note: wear off = 药效、疼痛、情绪慢慢消失。
chunks.ex_en: The pain slowly wore off after an hour.
chunks.ex_cn: 一小时后疼痛慢慢消退了。

chunks.head: wear out
chunks.note: wear out = 用旧、磨破；也指把人累垮。
chunks.ex_en: These old shoes are completely worn out.
chunks.ex_cn: 这双旧鞋已经完全磨破了。

chunks.head: occur to
chunks.note: occur to sb = 某人（突然）想到。
chunks.ex_en: It never occurred to me that he might lie.
chunks.ex_cn: 我从没想到他会撒谎。

chunks.head: become of
chunks.gloss: （某人/某物）会怎么样、下场如何
chunks.note: what becomes of sb = 某人后来怎样了（问下落/结局）。
chunks.ex_en: What became of your old bike?
chunks.ex_cn: 你那辆旧自行车后来怎么样了？

chunks.head: cry out
chunks.note: cry out = 突然喊出声（疼痛/惊恐/呼救）。
chunks.ex_en: He cried out for help in the dark.
chunks.ex_cn: 他在黑暗中大声呼救。

chunks.head: burst out
chunks.note: burst out + crying/laughing = 突然大哭/大笑；泪水 burst out = 夺眶而出。
chunks.ex_en: Tears burst out as she read the letter.
chunks.ex_cn: 她读信时泪水夺眶而出。

chunks.head: look back upon
chunks.note: look back on/upon = 回首往事。
chunks.ex_en: We often look back upon our school days.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们常常回想学生时代。

chunks.head: struck dumb
chunks.gloss: 惊得说不出话、哑口无言
chunks.note: be struck dumb = 因震惊一时语塞。
chunks.ex_en: The bad news struck her dumb for a moment.
chunks.ex_cn: 那坏消息让她一时说不出话。

chunks.head: at large
chunks.gloss: 自由自在、可随意走动（不受拘束）
chunks.note: at large = 自由、未受拘束（也常指逃犯在逃）。
chunks.ex_en: The children were at large in the park all afternoon.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们整个下午在公园里自由自在地玩。

chunks.head: on shore
chunks.note: on shore = 在陆地上（对 at sea 而言）；come on shore = 上岸。
chunks.ex_en: The sailors rested on shore for two days.
chunks.ex_cn: 水手们在岸上休息了两天。

chunks.head: single out
chunks.note: single sb/sth out = 从众多中挑出某一个（常指特别对待）。
chunks.ex_en: The teacher singled out Tom for praise.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师单独点名表扬了汤姆。

chunks.head: one way or the other
chunks.gloss: 不管怎样；总归（用某种方式）
chunks.note: one way or the other = 以这样或那样的方式；无论如何。
chunks.ex_en: We must decide one way or the other by Friday.
chunks.ex_cn: 周五前我们必须做出决定，不管选哪样。

chunks.head: as it were
chunks.gloss: 可以说、仿佛；姑且这么说
chunks.note: as it were = 插入语，'可以说、姑且这么讲'。
chunks.ex_en: He is, as it were, the brain of the team.
chunks.ex_cn: 他可以说是这个团队的大脑。

chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.gloss: 大量的、许多（接不可数名词）
chunks.note: a great deal of + 不可数名词 = 很多。
chunks.ex_en: She spent a great deal of time on the project.
chunks.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上花了大量时间。

chunks.head: a great many
chunks.note: a great many + 可数复数 = 许多。
chunks.ex_en: A great many people came to the fair.
chunks.ex_cn: 很多人来赶集。

chunks.head: in short
chunks.note: in short = 概括前文，'简而言之'。
chunks.ex_en: In short, we need more time and money.
chunks.ex_cn: 简言之，我们需要更多时间和钱。

chunks.head: for the better
chunks.note: change/turn for the better = 好转；反义 for the worse。
chunks.ex_en: Her health changed for the better after the trip.
chunks.ex_cn: 旅行后她的健康好转了。

chunks.head: take notice of
chunks.note: 本章出处为倒装分离式（what notice had I taken of it），故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: Nobody took notice of the new student.
chunks.ex_cn: 没人留意那个新来的学生。
